veranderings.voor: 'n geboë spieël waardeur jy self kyk
veranderings.na: 'n geboë spieël. Jy kyk self daardeur
veranderings.rede: The relative clause attaches to the nearest noun, so it says you look through the mirror; a separate sentence makes 'daardeur' refer to the telescope.
Avoids 'baie groot ... baie seshoekige' twice in one sentence without changing the meaning.

veranderings.blok: Wiele en asse laat 'n rover rol
veranderings.rede: An Afrikaans compound with no vowel clash is written as one word under the AWS.

veranderings.voor: neem minute om aan te kom
veranderings.rede: 'Neem minute om aan te kom' calques 'takes minutes to arrive'; 'is minute lank onderweg' is the natural Afrikaans with the same meaning.
